"""Scientific figures from immutable history, never from regenerated model outputs."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import math
import shutil
import numpy as np
from src.evaluation.visualization import plt
from src.evaluation.history import read_group, read_csv
from src.evaluation.metrics import classification_metrics, LABEL_NAMES
from src.utils.config import ROOT
from src.utils.tracking import digest, file_hash, read_json, write_json, now

CLASS_NAMES = [name.title() for name in LABEL_NAMES]
COLORS = ['#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#009E73']
STYLE_VERSION = 'scientific-v2'


def row_normalize(matrix):
    matrix = np.asarray(matrix, dtype=float)
    totals = matrix.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    return np.divide(matrix, totals, out=np.zeros_like(matrix), where=totals != 0)


def prediction_metrics(rows):
    return classification_metrics([r['true_label'] for r in rows], [r['predicted_label'] for r in rows])


class FigureWriter:
    def __init__(self, output, model, sources, reuse=None, reuse_directory=None):
        self.output, self.model, self.sources = Path(output), model, sources
        self.images, self.skipped = [], []
        self.reuse, self.reuse_directory = reuse or {}, reuse_directory
        self.reused_figures = 0

    def save(self, fig, stem, title):
        path = self.output / stem
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        files = []
        try:
            previous = self.reuse.get(str(stem))
            if previous and previous['title'] == title:
                for item in previous['files']:
                    source = self.reuse_directory / item['path']
                    target = self.output / item['path']
                    if target.exists():
                        raise FileExistsError(f'Refusing to overwrite figure: {target}')
                    if file_hash(source) != item['sha256']:
                        raise ValueError(f'Previous figure checksum mismatch: {source}')
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    shutil.copy2(source, target)
                self.images.append(previous)
                self.reused_figures += 1
                return
            fig.suptitle(self.model + ' | ' + title, fontsize=11)
            fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, .94))
            for suffix in ('.png', '.svg'):
                target = path.with_suffix(suffix)
                if target.exists():
                    raise FileExistsError(f'Refusing to overwrite figure: {target}')
                fig.savefig(target, dpi=220, bbox_inches='tight')
                files.append({'path': target.relative_to(self.output).as_posix(), 'sha256': file_hash(target)})
            self.images.append({'figure': str(stem), 'title': title, 'files': files})
        finally:
            plt.close(fig)

    def skip(self, figure, reason):
        self.skipped.append({'figure': figure, 'status': 'skipped', 'reason': reason})

    def line(self, stem, title, series, xlabel, ylabel, best=None, zero=False):
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.6))
        for index, (label, xs, ys) in enumerate(series):
            ax.plot(xs, ys, label=label, color=COLORS[index % len(COLORS)], linewidth=1.4)
        if best is not None:
            ax.axvline(best, color='#666666', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label=f'Best epoch {best}')
        if zero:
            ax.axhline(0, color='#777777', linewidth=.8)
        ax.set(xlabel=xlabel, ylabel=ylabel)
        ax.legend(fontsize=8)
        self.save(fig, stem, title)

    def bars(self, stem, title, labels, values, ylabel, bounded=False):
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(7, len(labels) * .65), 4.8))
        ax.bar(labels, values, color=COLORS[0])
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
        if bounded:
            ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        if len(labels) > 8:
            ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelrotation=45)
        self.save(fig, stem, title)

    def grouped(self, stem, title, labels, groups, ylabel, bounded=True):
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(max(7, len(labels) * .7), 4.8))
        xs = np.arange(len(labels))
        width = .8 / len(groups)
        for i, (name, values) in enumerate(groups.items()):
            ax.bar(xs - .4 + width * (i + .5), values, width, label=name, color=COLORS[i % len(COLORS)])
        ax.set(xticks=xs, xticklabels=labels, ylabel=ylabel)
        if bounded:
            ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
        if len(labels) > 8:
            ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelrotation=45)
        ax.legend(fontsize=8)
        self.save(fig, stem, title)

    def heatmap(self, stem, title, values, row_names, column_names, normalized=True):
        values = np.asarray(values)
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, max(4.5, len(row_names) * .35)))
        plot = ax.imshow(values, cmap='Blues', vmin=0, vmax=1 if normalized else None, aspect='auto')
        ax.set(xticks=range(len(column_names)), yticks=range(len(row_names)), xticklabels=column_names, yticklabels=row_names,
               xlabel='Class', ylabel='Subject / fold')
        for i in range(len(row_names)):
            for j in range(len(column_names)):
                ax.text(j, i, f'{values[i, j]:.2f}' if normalized else f'{values[i,j]:.0f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8,
                        color='white' if normalized and values[i, j] > .65 else 'black')
        fig.colorbar(plot, ax=ax, label='F1 score' if normalized else 'Count')
        self.save(fig, stem, title)

    def confusion(self, stem, title, matrix, normalized=False):
        values = row_normalize(matrix) if normalized else np.asarray(matrix)
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
        image = ax.imshow(values, cmap='Blues', vmin=0, vmax=1 if normalized else None)
        ax.set(xticks=range(len(CLASS_NAMES)), yticks=range(len(CLASS_NAMES)), xticklabels=CLASS_NAMES, yticklabels=CLASS_NAMES,
               xlabel='Predicted class', ylabel='True class')
        for i, row in enumerate(values):
            for j, value in enumerate(row):
                text = f'{value:.1%}' if normalized else f'{int(value)}'
                ax.text(j, i, text, ha='center', va='center', color='white' if value > values.max() * .6 else 'black')
        fig.colorbar(image, ax=ax, label='Recall within true class' if normalized else 'Windows (count)')
        self.save(fig, stem, title)


def values(rows, key):
    return [float(r[key]) if r.get(key) is not None else np.nan for r in rows]


def learning_figures(writer, fold):
    seed, fid = fold.metadata['training_seed'], fold.metadata['fold_id']
    prefix = f'training/seed_{seed}/fold_{fid:02d}'
    title = f'Seed {seed} | Fold {fid:02d}'
    epochs = [r['epoch'] for r in fold.epochs]
    best = fold.metadata['best_epoch']
    for name, fields, ylabel in [('loss', [('Train eval', 'train_eval_loss'), ('Validation', 'val_loss'), ('Train online', 'train_online_loss')], 'Weighted cross-entropy loss'),
                                  ('accuracy', [('Train', 'train_accuracy'), ('Validation', 'val_accuracy')], 'Accuracy'),
                                  ('macro_f1', [('Train', 'train_macro_f1'), ('Validation', 'val_macro_f1')], 'Macro-F1'),
                                  ('balanced_accuracy', [('Train', 'train_balanced_accuracy'), ('Validation', 'val_balanced_accuracy')], 'Balanced accuracy')]:
        if not all(any(r.get(key) is not None for r in fold.epochs) for _, key in fields):
            writer.skip(prefix + '/' + name, 'Required epoch metrics are absent in the historical schema; no estimates or interpolation were used.')
            continue
        writer.line(prefix + '/' + name, title + ' | Train vs validation ' + name.replace('_', ' '),
                    [(label, epochs, values(fold.epochs, key)) for label, key in fields], 'Epoch', ylabel, best=best)
    steps = [r['global_step'] for r in fold.iterations]
    for name, key, ylabel in [('batch_loss', 'train_loss', 'Batch weighted cross-entropy loss'),
                              ('gradient_norm', 'gradient_norm', 'Gradient L2 norm (before clipping)')]:
        if any(r.get(key) is not None for r in fold.iterations):
            writer.line(prefix + '/' + name, title + ' | ' + name.replace('_', ' '), [('Training', steps, values(fold.iterations, key))], 'Committed global step', ylabel)
        else:
            writer.skip(prefix + '/' + name, key + ' unavailable')
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(8, 6))
    axes[0].plot(epochs, values(fold.epochs, 'learning_rate'), color=COLORS[0])
    axes[0].set(xlabel='Epoch', ylabel='Learning rate')
    axes[1].plot(steps, values(fold.iterations, 'learning_rate'), color=COLORS[0])
    axes[1].set(xlabel='Committed global step', ylabel='Learning rate')
    writer.save(fig, prefix + '/learning_rate', title + ' | Learning rate')
    gap = np.asarray(values(fold.epochs, 'train_macro_f1')) - np.asarray(values(fold.epochs, 'val_macro_f1'))
    writer.line(prefix + '/macro_f1_gap', title + ' | Train-validation gap', [('Train minus validation', epochs, gap)], 'Epoch', 'Macro-F1 difference', best=best, zero=True)
    writer.line(prefix + '/epoch_duration', title + ' | Epoch duration', [('Duration', epochs, values(fold.epochs, 'epoch_duration_seconds'))], 'Epoch', 'Duration (seconds)')


def evaluation_figures(writer, fold):
    seed, fid = fold.metadata['training_seed'], fold.metadata['fold_id']
    suffix = f'seed_{seed}/fold_{fid:02d}'
    title = f'Seed {seed} | Fold {fid:02d} | Test'
    metrics = prediction_metrics(fold.predictions)
    writer.confusion('confusion_matrices/' + suffix + '/raw', title + ' confusion matrix', metrics['confusion_matrix'])
    writer.confusion('confusion_matrices/' + suffix + '/normalized', title + ' row-normalized confusion matrix', metrics['confusion_matrix'], True)
    writer.grouped('class_metrics/' + suffix + '/precision_recall_f1', title + ' | Per-class performance', CLASS_NAMES,
                   {name: metrics[name.lower() + '_per_class'] for name in ('Precision', 'Recall', 'F1')}, 'Score')
    true = np.bincount([r['true_label'] for r in fold.predictions], minlength=len(CLASS_NAMES))
    pred = np.bincount([r['predicted_label'] for r in fold.predictions], minlength=len(CLASS_NAMES))
    writer.grouped('class_metrics/' + suffix + '/label_distribution', title + ' | Label distribution', CLASS_NAMES, {'True': true, 'Predicted': pred}, 'Windows (count)', False)
    return metrics


def seed_figures(writer, seed, folds):
    rows = [r for f in folds for r in f.predictions]
    title = f'Seed {seed} | OOF test'
    metrics_by_subject = {}
    for subject in sorted({r['subject_id'] for r in rows}, key=lambda s: int(s.lstrip('S')) if s.lstrip('S').isdigit() else s):
        selected = [r for r in rows if r['subject_id'] == subject]
        metrics = prediction_metrics(selected)
        metrics_by_subject[subject] = metrics
        target = f'error_analysis/seed_{seed}/S8' if subject == 'S8' else f'subject_metrics/seed_{seed}/{subject}'
        writer.confusion(target + '/confusion_raw', title + f' | {subject} confusion matrix', metrics['confusion_matrix'])
        writer.confusion(target + '/confusion_normalized', title + f' | {subject} row-normalized confusion matrix', metrics['confusion_matrix'], True)
    subjects = list(metrics_by_subject)
    fold_labels = [str(f.metadata['fold_id']) for f in folds]
    for key, label in [('macro_f1', 'Macro-F1'), ('balanced_accuracy', 'Balanced accuracy'), ('accuracy', 'Accuracy')]:
        writer.bars(f'subject_metrics/seed_{seed}/{key}', title + ' | ' + label + ' by subject', subjects, [metrics_by_subject[s][key] for s in subjects], label, True)
        writer.bars(f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/{key}', title + ' | ' + label + ' by fold', fold_labels, [f.test[key] for f in folds], label, True)
    writer.heatmap(f'subject_metrics/seed_{seed}/class_f1_heatmap', title + ' | Subject x class F1', [metrics_by_subject[s]['f1_per_class'] for s in subjects], subjects, CLASS_NAMES)
    writer.grouped(f'subject_metrics/seed_{seed}/class_f1', title + ' | Per-class F1 by subject', subjects,
                   {name: [metrics_by_subject[s]['f1_per_class'][c] for s in subjects] for c, name in enumerate(CLASS_NAMES)}, 'F1 score')
    writer.heatmap(f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/class_f1_heatmap', title + ' | Fold x class F1', [f.test['f1_per_class'] for f in folds], fold_labels, CLASS_NAMES)
    writer.grouped(f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/class_f1', title + ' | Per-class F1 by fold', fold_labels,
                   {name: [f.test['f1_per_class'][c] for f in folds] for c, name in enumerate(CLASS_NAMES)}, 'F1 score')
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.6))
    keys = ['macro_f1', 'balanced_accuracy', 'accuracy']
    ax.boxplot([[f.test[key] for f in folds] for key in keys], positions=range(len(keys)))
    ax.set(xticks=range(len(keys)), xticklabels=['Macro-F1', 'Balanced accuracy', 'Accuracy'], ylabel='Fold-level test score', ylim=(0, 1))
    writer.save(fig, f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/metrics_boxplot', title + f' | Distribution across {len(folds)} folds')
    for key, label in [('best_epoch', 'Best epoch'), ('completed_epochs', 'Completed epochs'), ('training_duration_seconds', 'Training duration (seconds)')]:
        writer.bars(f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/{key}', f'Seed {seed} | Training | ' + label + ' by fold', fold_labels, [f.metadata[key] for f in folds], label)
    pooled = prediction_metrics(rows)
    for normalized in (False, True):
        writer.confusion(f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/aggregate_confusion_' + ('normalized' if normalized else 'raw'), title + ' | Pooled confusion matrix', pooled['confusion_matrix'], normalized)
    for key, train_key, val_key, ylabel in [('loss', 'train_eval_loss', 'val_loss', 'Weighted CE loss'), ('macro_f1', 'train_macro_f1', 'val_macro_f1', 'Macro-F1'), ('balanced_accuracy', 'train_balanced_accuracy', 'val_balanced_accuracy', 'Balanced accuracy'), ('accuracy', 'train_accuracy', 'val_accuracy', 'Accuracy')]:
        available = [f for f in folds if any(r.get(train_key) is not None and r.get(val_key) is not None for r in f.epochs)]
        if not available:
            writer.skip(f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/learning_{key}', 'Epoch ' + key + ' unavailable; historical metrics were not manufactured.')
            continue
        cols = min(2, len(available))
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(math.ceil(len(available) / cols), cols, figsize=(6 * cols, 3.6 * math.ceil(len(available) / cols)), squeeze=False)
        for axis, fold in zip(axes.flat, available):
            epochs = [r['epoch'] for r in fold.epochs]
            for name, field, color in [('Train eval', train_key, COLORS[0]), ('Validation', val_key, COLORS[1])]:
                axis.plot(epochs, values(fold.epochs, field), label=name, color=color)

            axis.set(title=f"Fold {fold.metadata['fold_id']:02d}", xlabel='Epoch', ylabel=ylabel)
            axis.legend(fontsize=8)
        for axis in list(axes.flat)[len(available):]:
            axis.set_visible(False)
        writer.save(fig, f'cross_fold/seed_{seed}/learning_{key}', f'Seed {seed} | Train / Validation | {ylabel} learning curves across folds')
    error_figures(writer, seed, rows, metrics_by_subject)
    return {'folds': {str(f.metadata['fold_id']): f.test for f in folds}, 'subjects': metrics_by_subject, 'pooled_oof': pooled}


def error_figures(writer, seed, rows, subject_metrics):
    selected = [r for r in rows if r['subject_id'] == 'S8']
    if not selected:
        writer.skip(f'error_analysis/seed_{seed}/S8', 'S8 is absent from these test predictions.')

    title = f'Seed {seed} | S8 | OOF test'

    predicted = np.bincount([r['predicted_label'] for r in selected], minlength=len(CLASS_NAMES))

        ax.legend()
        writer.save(fig, prefix + '/confidence_distribution', title + ' | Prediction confidence')
    else:
        writer.skip(prefix + '/confidence_distribution', 'Per-class probabilities are missing.')
    if all(row.get('start_time') is not None for row in selected):

        axes[1].set_xlabel('Window start time in recording (seconds)')
        writer.save(fig, prefix + '/label_timeline', title + ' | True vs predicted timeline (gaps preserved)')
    else:
        writer.skip(prefix + '/label_timeline', 'Window timestamps are missing.')
    others = [m for name, m in subject_metrics.items() if name != 'S8']
    if others:
        writer.grouped(prefix + '/comparison', title + ' | S8 vs other subjects', ['Macro-F1', 'Balanced accuracy', 'Accuracy'],

def generate_visualizations(group_id, root=ROOT):
    history = read_group(group_id, root)
    cache = Path(history['manifest'].get('cache_path', ''))
    sources = dict(history['source_hashes'])
    if cache.is_dir():
        for path in sorted(cache.glob('*/*')):
            if path.name in ('metadata.json', 'windows.csv', 'windows.npy'):
                sources[str(path)] = file_hash(path)
    # Plotting code changes must invalidate the generation cache as well as data.
    generator_key = Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    sources[generator_key] = file_hash(Path(__file__))
    generation_id = STYLE_VERSION + '_' + digest(sources)[:16]
    base = history['result'] / 'enhanced_visualizations'
    output = base / generation_id
    marker = output / 'generation_manifest.json'
    if marker.exists():
        manifest = read_json(marker)
        if manifest['status'] == 'completed' and all(file_hash(output / item['path']) == item['sha256'] for image in manifest['images'] for item in image['files']):
            print(f'[REUSE] {len(manifest["images"])} existing figures; no files overwritten.')
            return manifest, output
    if output.exists():
        # Failed/incomplete generations remain intact for inspection.
        from src.utils.tracking import identifier
        output = base / (generation_id + '_' + identifier())
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    config = history['manifest']['effective_config']
    reuse, reuse_directory = {}, None
    previous_marker = base / 'generation_manifest.json'
    if previous_marker.exists():
        previous = read_json(previous_marker)
        # Only the label correction from v1 to v2 can reuse images. Numerical
        # inputs must match exactly; any later style/code version renders anew.
        data_sources = {k: v for k, v in sources.items() if k != generator_key}
        if (previous.get('status') == 'completed' and previous.get('style_version') == 'scientific-v1'
                and previous['source_hashes'] == data_sources):
            reuse_directory = base / previous['generation_directory']
            reuse = {entry['figure']: entry for entry in previous['images']}
    writer = FigureWriter(output, config['experiment']['id'] + ' / ' + config['experiment']['model'], sources,
                          reuse=reuse, reuse_directory=reuse_directory)
    manifest = {'status': 'running', 'group_id': group_id, 'style_version': STYLE_VERSION, 'generated_at': now(),
                'source_hashes': sources, 'images': writer.images, 'skipped': writer.skipped, 'metrics_by_seed': {}}
    style = {'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans', 'font.size': 10, 'axes.grid': True, 'axes.axisbelow': True,
             'grid.alpha': .18, 'axes.spines.top': False, 'axes.spines.right': False, 'svg.fonttype': 'none'}
    try:
        with plt.rc_context(style):
            seeds = defaultdict(list)
            for fold in history['folds']:
                learning_figures(writer, fold)
                evaluation_figures(writer, fold)
                seeds[fold.metadata['training_seed']].append(fold)
            for seed, folds in seeds.items():
                manifest['metrics_by_seed'][str(seed)] = seed_figures(writer, seed, folds)
            dataset_figures(writer, history)
        manifest.update(status='completed', figure_count=len(writer.images), file_count=sum(len(image['files']) for image in writer.images), dpi=220,
                        reused_figures=writer.reused_figures, rendered_figures=len(writer.images) - writer.reused_figures)
    except BaseException as exc:
        manifest.update(status='failed', error=f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
        raise
    finally:
        write_json(output / 'generation_manifest.json', manifest)
    write_json(base / 'generation_manifest.json', {**manifest, 'generation_directory': output.name})
    if writer.skipped:
        print(f'[WARNING] {len(writer.skipped)} figures skipped for unavailable inputs; see generation_manifest.json.')
    for entry in writer.images:
        for item in entry['files']:
            print(output / item['path'])
    print(f'Generated {len(writer.images)} figures / {manifest["file_count"]} PNG+SVG files; skipped {len(writer.skipped)}.')
    return manifest, output

"""Evaluation without gradients; weighted loss normalized over all samples."""
import csv
import numpy as np
import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F
from src.evaluation.metrics import classification_metrics, LABEL_NAMES
from src.utils.tracking import write_json


@torch.inference_mode()
def evaluate(model, loader, device, weights):
    model.eval()
    labels, predictions, probabilities, indices = [], [], [], []
    numerator, denominator = 0.0, 0.0
    for x, y, index in loader:
        x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
        logits = model(x)
        if not torch.isfinite(logits).all():
            raise FloatingPointError('NaN/Inf evaluation logits')
        numerator += F.cross_entropy(logits, y, weight=weights, reduction='sum').item()
        denominator += weights[y].sum().item()
        probabilities.extend(logits.softmax(dim=1).cpu().numpy())
        predictions.extend(logits.argmax(dim=1).cpu().tolist())
        labels.extend(y.cpu().tolist())
        indices.extend(index.tolist())
    metrics = classification_metrics(labels, predictions)
    metrics['loss'] = numerator / denominator
    return metrics, np.asarray(probabilities), np.asarray(indices)


def export_test(folder, dataset, metrics, probabilities, indices, fold_id):
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    for probability, index in zip(probabilities, indices):
        row = dataset.rows[index]
        rows.append({'fold_id': fold_id, 'subject_id': row['subject_id'], 'window_id': row['window_id'],
                     'start_time': row['start_time'], 'end_time': row['end_time'], 'true_label': row['label'],
                     'predicted_label': int(probability.argmax()),
                     **{f'p_{name}': float(probability[c]) for c, name in enumerate(LABEL_NAMES)}})
    write_csv(folder / 'predictions.csv', rows)
    subject_rows = []
    for subject in dataset.subjects:
        selected = [r for r in rows if r['subject_id'] == subject]
        m = classification_metrics([r['true_label'] for r in selected], [r['predicted_label'] for r in selected])
        subject_rows.append({'fold_id': fold_id, 'subject_id': subject, 'windows': len(selected), **{k: m[k] for k in ('macro_f1', 'balanced_accuracy', 'accuracy')}})
    write_csv(folder / 'subject_metrics.csv', subject_rows)
    write_json(folder / 'test.json', metrics)
    write_json(folder / 'classification_report.json', {name: {key: metrics[key + '_per_class'][i] for key in ['precision', 'recall', 'f1']} | {'support': metrics['support'][i]} for i, name in enumerate(LABEL_NAMES)})
    np.savetxt(folder / 'confusion_matrix.csv', metrics['confusion_matrix'], delimiter=',', fmt='%d', header=','.join(LABEL_NAMES), comments='')


def write_csv(path, rows):
    if not rows:
        raise ValueError('Cannot export empty results.')
    with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)

"""Fixed label order, including explicit handling of absent classes."""
import warnings
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, precision_recall_fscore_support

LABEL_NAMES = ['baseline', 'stress', 'amusement']


def classification_metrics(labels, predictions):
    labels, predictions = np.asarray(labels), np.asarray(predictions)
    if not len(labels) or labels.shape != predictions.shape or not np.isin(labels, [0, 1, 2]).all() or not np.isin(predictions, [0, 1, 2]).all():
        raise ValueError('Metrics require nonempty aligned three-class labels.')
    precision, recall, f1, support = precision_recall_fscore_support(labels, predictions, labels=[0, 1, 2], zero_division=0)
    absent = [LABEL_NAMES[i] for i in np.flatnonzero(support == 0)]
    if absent:
        warnings.warn('Absent classes: ' + ', '.join(absent) + '; fixed-label macro scores assign zero recall/F1.', RuntimeWarning)
    return {'macro_f1': float(f1.mean()), 'balanced_accuracy': float(recall.mean()),
            'accuracy': float((labels == predictions).mean()), 'precision_per_class': precision.tolist(),
            'recall_per_class': recall.tolist(), 'f1_per_class': f1.tolist(), 'support': support.tolist(),
            'confusion_matrix': confusion_matrix(labels, predictions, labels=[0, 1, 2]).tolist(),
            'label_order': LABEL_NAMES, 'absent_classes': absent}

"""Atomic trusted local checkpoints. last.pt defines committed epochs."""
import os
import uuid
import torch
from pathlib import Path


def save_checkpoint(path, state):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + '.' + uuid.uuid4().hex + '.tmp')
    with temporary.open('wb') as stream:
        torch.save(state, stream)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def load_checkpoint(path):
    # Only checkpoints produced by this project in the local run directory.
    return torch.load(path, map_location='cpu', weights_only=False)

"""Train a fold, recover at epoch boundaries, select exclusively on validation."""
import copy
import time
import warnings
import numpy as np
import torch
import yaml
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
from src.data.dataset import WindowDataset
from src.data.normalization import ChannelScaler
from src.models.cnn import CNN1D
from src.training.optimizer import make_optimizer, class_weights
from src.training.callbacks import SelectionState
from src.training.checkpoint import save_checkpoint, load_checkpoint
from src.evaluation.evaluator import evaluate, export_test
from src.evaluation.visualization import training_plots, confusion_plot
from src.utils.experiment_tracking import TrainingTracker
from src.utils.config import same_training_config
from src.utils.reproducibility import seed_everything, rng_state, restore_rng
from src.utils.tracking import now, identifier, write_json, read_json, file_hash


def completed_fold(folder):
    marker = folder / 'completion.json'
    if not marker.exists():
        return False
    recorded = read_json(marker)
    if not all((folder / f).is_file() and file_hash(folder / f) == h for f, h in recorded['files'].items()):
        raise ValueError(f'Completed fold artifacts were modified or are missing: {folder}')
    return read_json(folder / 'metadata.json')['status'] == 'completed'


def recover_epoch_logs(logger, history):
    """Repair the small crash interval after checkpoint commit but before log append."""
    for field, method in [('epoch_log', logger.epoch), ('validation_log', logger.validation)]:
        for record in history:
            row = record[field]
            # Idempotent writes also reconcile a missing v2 sidecar after a crash.
            method(row)


def train_fold(folder, cache, fold, seed, config, manifest_checksum, resume=False, interrupt=None, group_id=None, total_folds=None):
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if completed_fold(folder):
        if not resume:
            raise FileExistsError('Completed fold exists; use resume to skip it.')
        print(f'[SKIP] seed={seed} fold={fold["fold_id"]}', flush=True)
        return read_json(folder / 'metadata.json')
    logger = TrainingTracker(folder / 'logs', config)
    attempt = identifier()
    metadata_path = folder / 'metadata.json'
    metadata = read_json(metadata_path) if metadata_path.exists() else {
        'run_id': identifier(), 'fold_id': fold['fold_id'], 'training_seed': seed,
        'subjects': fold, 'started_at': now(), 'manifest_checksum': manifest_checksum,
        'effective_config': config, 'attempts': []}
    if not same_training_config(metadata['effective_config'], config) or metadata['manifest_checksum'] != manifest_checksum or metadata['subjects'] != fold or metadata['training_seed'] != seed:
        raise ValueError('Resume metadata/config/split/seed mismatch.')
    metadata['attempts'].append({'attempt_id': attempt, 'started_at': now()})
    metadata['status'] = 'running'
    metadata['effective_config'] = config
    write_json(metadata_path, metadata)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    history, elapsed_before = [], 0.0
    try:
        seed_everything(seed, config['runtime']['deterministic'], config['runtime']['torch_threads'])
        requested = config['runtime']['device']
        device = torch.device(('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu') if requested == 'auto' else requested)
        logger.event('fold_start', run_id=metadata['run_id'], attempt_id=attempt, fold_id=fold['fold_id'], seed=seed, device=str(device))
        datasets = {role: WindowDataset(cache, fold[role]) for role in ('train', 'validation', 'test')}
        scaler = ChannelScaler().fit(datasets['train'])
        scaler.save(folder / 'normalization.json')
        for dataset in datasets.values():
            dataset.scaler = scaler
        logger.event('preprocessing', train_subjects=fold['train'], validation_subjects=fold['validation'], test_subjects=fold['test'], window_counts={k: len(v) for k, v in datasets.items()})
        tc = config['training']
        loaders = {role: DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=tc['batch_size'], shuffle=False, num_workers=config['runtime']['num_workers']) for role, dataset in datasets.items()}
        train_loader = DataLoader(datasets['train'], batch_size=tc['batch_size'], shuffle=True, num_workers=config['runtime']['num_workers'])
        model = CNN1D(datasets['train'].arrays[fold['train'][0]].shape[1]).to(device)
        optimizer = make_optimizer(model, tc)
        weights = class_weights(datasets['train'].labels).to(device)
        criterion = torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss(weight=weights)
        selection = SelectionState(tc['early_stopping_patience'], tc['early_stopping_min_delta'])
        last_path, best_path = folder / 'checkpoints/last.pt', folder / 'checkpoints/best.pt'
        epoch_start, step, best_state = 1, 0, None
        cache_keys = {s: key for dataset in datasets.values() for s, key in dataset.cache_keys.items()}
        if last_path.exists():
            if not resume:
                raise FileExistsError('Checkpoint exists; explicit resume required.')
            state = load_checkpoint(last_path)
            if not same_training_config(state['effective_config'], config) or state['manifest_checksum'] != manifest_checksum or state['cache_keys'] != cache_keys or state['run_id'] != metadata['run_id']:
                raise ValueError('Checkpoint identity/config/cache checksum mismatch.')
            model.load_state_dict(state['model'])
            optimizer.load_state_dict(state['optimizer'])
            selection.__dict__.update(state['early_stopping'])
            epoch_start, step = state['epoch'] + 1, state['global_step']
            history, best_state, elapsed_before = state['history'], state['best_model'], state['training_duration_seconds']
            # last.pt is authoritative even if an interrupted future epoch wrote best.pt.
            save_checkpoint(best_path, {**state, 'model': best_state, 'epoch': selection.best_epoch, 'checkpoint_kind': 'best'})
            recover_epoch_logs(logger, history)
            restore_rng(state['rng'])
            logger.event('resume', epoch_start=epoch_start, committed_global_step=step, attempt_id=attempt)
        elif resume:
            logger.event('resume', epoch_start=1, reason='No committed epoch; replay with a new attempt ID', attempt_id=attempt)
        metadata.update(logging_schema_version=2, device=str(device), architecture=str(model), trainable_parameters=sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad),
                        window_counts={k: len(v) for k, v in datasets.items()},
                        label_distribution={k: np.bincount(v.labels, minlength=3).tolist() for k, v in datasets.items()},
                        class_weights=weights.cpu().tolist(), cache_keys=cache_keys)
        (folder / 'config.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(config, sort_keys=False), encoding='utf-8')
        write_json(metadata_path, metadata)
        logger.event('model', parameters=metadata['trainable_parameters'])
        logger.start_run(metadata, group_id or folder.parent.parent.name, total_folds or fold['fold_id'],
                         {'history': history, 'epoch': epoch_start - 1, 'global_step': step} if resume else None)
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
            warnings.simplefilter('always', RuntimeWarning)
            for epoch in range(epoch_start, tc['max_epochs'] + 1):
                if selection.bad_epochs >= selection.patience:
                    break
                epoch_time = time.perf_counter()
                logger.event('epoch_start', epoch=epoch, attempt_id=attempt)
                logger.start_epoch(epoch, tc['max_epochs'], len(train_loader))
                model.train()
                numerator, denominator = 0.0, 0.0
                for batch_index, (x, y, _) in enumerate(train_loader):
                    batch_time = time.perf_counter()
                    x, y = x.to(device), y.to(device)
                    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
                    logits = model(x)
                    loss = criterion(logits, y)
                    if not torch.isfinite(loss):
                        raise FloatingPointError('NaN/Inf training loss')
                    loss.backward()
                    norm = torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), tc['gradient_clip_norm'], error_if_nonfinite=True)
                    optimizer.step()
                    step += 1
                    weight_sum = weights[y].sum().item()
                    numerator += loss.item() * weight_sum
                    denominator += weight_sum
                    logger.log_batch({'run_id': metadata['run_id'], 'attempt_id': attempt, 'fold_id': fold['fold_id'], 'training_seed': seed,
                                      'epoch': epoch, 'batch_index': batch_index, 'global_step': step, 'batch_size': len(y),
                                      'train_loss': loss.item(), 'learning_rate': optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr'], 'gradient_norm': norm.item(),
                                      'batch_duration_ms': (time.perf_counter() - batch_time) * 1000, 'timestamp': now()})
                    if interrupt:
                        interrupt(epoch, batch_index)
                train_metrics, _, _ = evaluate(model, loaders['train'], device, weights)
                val, _, _ = evaluate(model, loaders['validation'], device, weights)
                better, stop = selection.update(val['macro_f1'], val['loss'], epoch)
                if better:
                    best_state = {k: v.detach().cpu().clone() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
                epoch_row = {'attempt_id': attempt, 'epoch': epoch, 'train_online_loss': numerator / denominator, 'train_eval_loss': train_metrics['loss'],
                             'early_stopping_counter': selection.bad_epochs,
                             'train_accuracy': train_metrics['accuracy'], 'val_accuracy': val['accuracy'],
                             'train_macro_f1': train_metrics['macro_f1'], 'train_balanced_accuracy': train_metrics['balanced_accuracy'],
                             'val_loss': val['loss'], 'val_macro_f1': val['macro_f1'], 'val_balanced_accuracy': val['balanced_accuracy'],
                             'learning_rate': optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr'], 'epoch_duration_seconds': time.perf_counter() - epoch_time,
                             'best_epoch': selection.best_epoch, 'best_val_macro_f1': selection.best_score}
                val_row = {'attempt_id': attempt, 'epoch': epoch, 'val_loss': val['loss'], 'val_macro_f1': val['macro_f1'], 'val_balanced_accuracy': val['balanced_accuracy'],
                           'val_accuracy': val['accuracy'],
                           'val_precision_per_class': val['precision_per_class'], 'val_recall_per_class': val['recall_per_class'], 'val_f1_per_class': val['f1_per_class'], 'is_best_checkpoint': better}
                history.append({**epoch_row, 'epoch_log': epoch_row, 'validation_log': val_row})
                state = {'model': model.state_dict(), 'optimizer': optimizer.state_dict(), 'scheduler': None, 'epoch': epoch,
                         'best_epoch': selection.best_epoch, 'best_validation_score': selection.best_score, 'early_stopping': copy.deepcopy(selection.__dict__),
                         'rng': rng_state(), 'effective_config': config, 'manifest_checksum': manifest_checksum, 'cache_keys': cache_keys,
                         'run_id': metadata['run_id'], 'attempt_id': attempt, 'global_step': step, 'history': history, 'best_model': best_state,
                         'training_duration_seconds': elapsed_before + time.perf_counter() - started, 'checkpoint_kind': 'last'}
                if better:
                    save_checkpoint(best_path, {**state, 'model': best_state, 'checkpoint_kind': 'best'})
                save_checkpoint(last_path, state)
                logger.log_epoch(epoch_row, val_row, {'is_best': better, 'bad_epochs': selection.bad_epochs,
                    'elapsed': elapsed_before + time.perf_counter() - started})
                if better:
                    logger.log_checkpoint(best_path, selection.best_epoch, selection.best_score)
                logger.event('validation_completed', epoch=epoch, val_macro_f1=val['macro_f1'], val_loss=val['loss'])
                logger.event('checkpoint_saved', epoch=epoch, best=better)
                logger.event('epoch_end', epoch=epoch, **{k: epoch_row[k] for k in ('train_online_loss', 'val_macro_f1', 'best_epoch')})
                if stop:
                    logger.event('early_stopping', epoch=epoch, patience=selection.patience)
                    break
            if not history:
                raise ValueError('No completed training epochs.')
            # Test loader is first consumed only after model selection has finished.
            model.load_state_dict(load_checkpoint(best_path)['model'])
            test, probabilities, indices = evaluate(model, loaders['test'], device, weights)
            export_test(folder / 'metrics', datasets['test'], test, probabilities, indices, fold['fold_id'])
            write_json(folder / 'metrics/best_validation.json', history[selection.best_epoch - 1]['validation_log'])
            training_plots(history, folder / 'plots')
            confusion_plot(test['confusion_matrix'], folder / 'plots/confusion_matrix.png')
            for warning in caught:
                with (logger.folder / 'errors.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                    stream.write(f'{now()} WARNING {warning.message}\n')
        metadata.update(status='completed', ended_at=now(), completed_epochs=len(history), best_epoch=selection.best_epoch,
                        best_val_macro_f1=selection.best_score, test_metrics=test,
                        training_duration_seconds=elapsed_before + time.perf_counter() - started,
                        checkpoints={'best': str(best_path), 'last': str(last_path)})
        write_json(metadata_path, metadata)
        logger.event('test_completed', macro_f1=test['macro_f1'], balanced_accuracy=test['balanced_accuracy'])
        logger.event('fold_end', status='completed')
        logger.log_test(test, metadata, sorted((folder / 'plots').glob('*.png')))
        logger.finish_run('completed')
        files = [p for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'completion.json' and '.tmp' not in p.name]
        write_json(folder / 'completion.json', {'files': {p.relative_to(folder).as_posix(): file_hash(p) for p in files}})
        return metadata
    except BaseException as exc:
        metadata.update(status='interrupted' if isinstance(exc, KeyboardInterrupt) else 'failed', error=repr(exc), ended_at=now())
        write_json(metadata_path, metadata)
        logger.error(exc)
        raise
    finally:
        logger.finish_run(metadata.get('status', 'failed'))

"""TTY progress bars and plain, capture-friendly scientific summaries."""
import sys
from datetime import timedelta
from tqdm.auto import tqdm


def number(value, digits=4):
    return 'N/A' if value is None or value == '' else f'{float(value):.{digits}f}'


class ConsoleLogger:
    def __init__(self, options=None, stream=None):
        self.options = options or {}
        self.stream = stream or sys.stdout
        self.enabled = self.options.get('enabled', True)
        self.bar = None
        self.context = {}

    def write(self, text):
        if self.enabled:
            if self.bar:
                self.bar.write(text, file=self.stream)
            else:
                print(text, file=self.stream, flush=True)

    def header(self, metadata, total_folds):
        self.context = metadata
        self.total_folds = total_folds
        config = metadata['effective_config']
        tc = config['training']
        lines = ['=' * 68, 'DL13-WESAD | DEEP LEARNING EXPERIMENT', '=' * 68]
        values = {'Experiment': config['experiment']['id'], 'Model': config['experiment']['model'],
                  'Fold': f"{metadata['fold_id']:02d}/{total_folds:02d}", 'Training Seed': metadata['training_seed'],
                  'Split Seed': config['split']['split_seed'], 'Device': metadata['device']}
        values.update({role.title() + ' Subjects': len(metadata['subjects'][role]) for role in ('train', 'validation', 'test')})
        values.update({role.title() + ' Windows': count for role, count in metadata['window_counts'].items()})
        values.update({'Parameters': metadata['trainable_parameters'], 'Optimizer': tc['optimizer'],
                       'Learning Rate': tc['learning_rate'], 'Batch Size': tc['batch_size'],
                       'Max Epochs': tc['max_epochs'], 'Early Stopping': f"Patience {tc['early_stopping_patience']}"})
        lines.extend(f'{name:<22}: {value}' for name, value in values.items())
        self.write('\n'.join(lines + ['=' * 68]))

    def start_epoch(self, epoch, total, batches):
        self.close_bar()
        mode = self.options.get('progress', 'auto')
        interactive = mode is True or mode == 'always' or (mode == 'auto' and self.stream.isatty())
        if self.enabled and interactive:
            label = f"Fold {self.context['fold_id']:02d}/{self.total_folds:02d} | Epoch {epoch:03d}/{total} TRAIN"
            self.bar = tqdm(total=batches, desc=label, file=self.stream, leave=False, dynamic_ncols=True,
                            ascii=True, mininterval=.25, unit='batch')

    def batch(self, row):
        if self.bar:
            self.bar.set_postfix(loss=number(row['train_loss']), lr=number(row['learning_rate'], 6), step=row['global_step'], refresh=False)
            self.bar.update(1)

    def close_bar(self):
        if self.bar is not None:
            self.bar.close()
            self.bar = None

    def epoch_summary(self, row, context):
        self.close_bar()
        config = self.context['effective_config']
        elapsed = context.get('elapsed')
        elapsed_text = 'N/A' if elapsed is None else str(timedelta(seconds=int(elapsed)))
        lines = ['-' * 68, f"{config['experiment']['id']} | {config['experiment']['model']} | Fold {self.context['fold_id']:02d}/{self.total_folds:02d} | Epoch {row['epoch']:03d}/{config['training']['max_epochs']}", '-' * 68]
        for title, prefix in [('TRAIN (end-of-epoch evaluation)', 'train'), ('VALIDATION', 'val')]:
            lines.append(title)
            for label, key in [('Loss', 'eval_loss' if prefix == 'train' else 'loss'), ('Accuracy', 'accuracy'), ('Macro-F1', 'macro_f1'), ('Balanced Accuracy', 'balanced_accuracy')]:
                lines.append(f'  {label:<20}: {number(row.get(prefix + "_" + key))}')
        lines.extend(['OPTIMIZATION', f"  Train online loss   : {number(row.get('train_online_loss'))}",
                      f"  Learning Rate       : {number(row.get('learning_rate'), 6)}",
                      f"  Epoch Duration      : {number(row.get('epoch_duration_seconds'), 1)} s",
                      f"  Total Elapsed       : {elapsed_text}",
                      'MODEL SELECTION', f"  Best Epoch          : {row['best_epoch']}",
                      f"  Best Val Macro-F1   : {number(row['best_val_macro_f1'])}",
                      f"  Patience            : {context.get('bad_epochs', 'N/A')}/{config['training']['early_stopping_patience']}",
                      '  Checkpoint          : ' + ('New best saved' if context.get('is_best') else 'No improvement'), '-' * 68])
        self.write('\n'.join(lines))

    def fold_summary(self, metadata):
        self.close_bar()
        metrics = metadata['test_metrics']
        lines = ['=' * 68, f"FOLD {metadata['fold_id']:02d}/{self.total_folds:02d} COMPLETED", '=' * 68]
        values = {'Best Epoch': metadata['best_epoch'], 'Epochs Completed': metadata['completed_epochs'],
                  'Test Accuracy': number(metrics.get('accuracy')), 'Test Macro-F1': number(metrics.get('macro_f1')),
                  'Test Bal. Acc': number(metrics.get('balanced_accuracy')), 'Training Time (s)': number(metadata['training_duration_seconds'], 1),
                  'Checkpoint': metadata['checkpoints']['best']}
        self.write('\n'.join(lines + [f'{k:<22}: {v}' for k, v in values.items()] + ['=' * 68]))

    def cv_summary(self, metadata):
        self.write('Fold | Seed | Epochs | Best | Test Accuracy | Test Macro-F1 | Test Bal. Acc')
        for m in metadata:
            test = m['test_metrics']
            self.write(f"{m['fold_id']:4d} | {m['training_seed']:4d} | {m['completed_epochs']:6d} | {m['best_epoch']:4d} | {number(test.get('accuracy')):>13} | {number(test.get('macro_f1')):>13} | {number(test.get('balanced_accuracy')):>13}")

"""One metric stream to local files, console and optional local TensorBoard."""
from pathlib import Path
from src.utils.console import ConsoleLogger
from src.utils.logging import RunLogger
from src.utils.tensorboard_tracker import TensorBoardTracker
from src.utils.tracking import write_json


class TrainingTracker:
    def __init__(self, folder, config):
        self.folder = Path(folder)
        self.local = RunLogger(self.folder, echo=False)
        self.console = ConsoleLogger(config.get('logging', {}).get('console'))
        self.tensorboard = TensorBoardTracker(config, self.folder.parent / 'tensorboard', warning=self.warning)

    def warning(self, message):
        self.local.event('tracking_warning', message=message)
        self.console.write('WARNING: ' + message)

    def event(self, event, **details):
        self.local.event(event, **details)
        if event in ('resume', 'early_stopping', 'failure', 'tracking_warning'):
            self.console.write(f'[{event.upper()}] {details}')

    def error(self, error):
        self.local.error(error)
        self.console.write(f'[FAILURE] {type(error).__name__}: {error}')

    def epoch(self, row):
        self.local.epoch(row)

    def validation(self, row):
        self.local.validation(row)

    def start_run(self, metadata, group_id, total_folds, resume_state=None):
        self.console.header(metadata, total_folds)
        self.local.message('RUN HEADER ' + str({k: metadata[k] for k in ('run_id', 'fold_id', 'training_seed', 'window_counts', 'trainable_parameters', 'device')}))
        identity = self.tensorboard.start_run(metadata, group_id, resume_state)
        if identity:
            write_json(self.folder.parent / 'tracking_identity.json', identity)

    def start_epoch(self, epoch, total, batches):
        self.console.start_epoch(epoch, total, batches)

    def log_batch(self, row):
        self.local.iteration(row)
        self.console.batch(row)
        self.tensorboard.log_batch(row)

    def log_epoch(self, row, validation, context):
        self.epoch(row)
        self.validation(validation)
        self.console.epoch_summary(row, context)
        self.local.message(f"EPOCH SUMMARY epoch={row['epoch']} train_accuracy={row.get('train_accuracy', 'N/A')} val_accuracy={row.get('val_accuracy', 'N/A')} train_eval_loss={row['train_eval_loss']} val_loss={row['val_loss']} train_macro_f1={row['train_macro_f1']} val_macro_f1={row['val_macro_f1']} train_balanced_accuracy={row['train_balanced_accuracy']} val_balanced_accuracy={row['val_balanced_accuracy']}")
        self.tensorboard.log_epoch(row)
        self.tensorboard.log_validation(validation)
        self.tensorboard.flush()

    def log_checkpoint(self, path, epoch, score):
        self.tensorboard.log_checkpoint(path, epoch, score)

    def log_test(self, metrics, metadata, figures):
        self.console.fold_summary(metadata)
        self.tensorboard.log_test(metrics, figures, metadata)
        self.tensorboard.flush()

    def finish_run(self, status):
        self.console.close_bar()
        self.tensorboard.finish_run(status)

"""Archived W&B replay tool, never called by active TensorBoard training."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from src.evaluation.history import read_group
from src.utils.config import ROOT, merge
from src.utils.tracking import digest, read_json, write_json
from src.utils.wandb_tracker import WandbTracker, redact


def import_history(group_id, mode='offline', dry_run=False, root=ROOT, overrides=None, sdk=None):
    if mode not in ('offline', 'online'):
        raise ValueError('Import mode must be explicitly offline or online.')
    history = read_group(group_id, root)
    # Archived, explicit-only importer; independent of the active TensorBoard schema.
    tracking = {'backend': 'wandb', 'strict': True, 'wandb': {'enabled': True, 'mode': mode,
        'project': 'DL13-WESAD', 'entity': None, 'batch_log_frequency': 10,
        'log_epoch_metrics': True, 'log_batch_metrics': True, 'log_system_metrics': False,
        'log_figures': True, 'log_confusion_matrix': True, 'upload_checkpoints': False,
        'upload_raw_data': False}}
    config = merge(history['manifest']['effective_config'], {'tracking': tracking})
    config = merge(config, overrides or {})
    # Historical import is metrics/derived figures only, even if future training enables artifacts.
    config['tracking']['wandb'].update(enabled=True, mode=mode, upload_checkpoints=False, upload_raw_data=False, log_system_metrics=False)
    frequency = config['tracking']['wandb']['batch_log_frequency']
    plan = {'group_id': group_id, 'mode': mode, 'historical_import': True, 'dry_run': dry_run, 'folds': [], 'imported': 0, 'skipped': 0}
    for fold in history['folds']:
        plan['folds'].append({'fold_id': fold.metadata['fold_id'], 'local_run_id': fold.metadata['run_id'],
            'training_seed': fold.metadata['training_seed'], 'epochs': len(fold.epochs), 'committed_batches': len(fold.iterations),
            'selected_wandb_batches': sum(int(r['global_step']) % frequency == 0 for r in fold.iterations),
            'missing_metrics': [key for key in ('train_accuracy', 'val_accuracy') if not any(r.get(key) is not None for r in fold.epochs)]})
    if dry_run:
        return plan
    output = history['result'] / 'wandb_imports'
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lock = output / '.import.lock'
    if lock.exists():
        previous = read_json(lock)
        try:
            alive = abs(psutil.Process(previous['pid']).create_time() - previous['created']) < .01
        except psutil.NoSuchProcess:
            alive = False
        if alive:
            raise RuntimeError('A historical import is already active.')
        lock.unlink()
    with lock.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        import json
        json.dump({'pid': os.getpid(), 'created': psutil.Process().create_time()}, stream)
    registry_path = output / 'import_registry.json'
    registry = read_json(registry_path) if registry_path.exists() else {'version': 1, 'imports': {}}
    try:
        for fold, item in zip(history['folds'], plan['folds']):
            wb = config['tracking']['wandb']
            key = digest({'local_run_id': fold.metadata['run_id'], 'group_id': group_id, 'project': wb['project'], 'entity': wb['entity'], 'mode': mode})
            source_id = digest(history['source_hashes'])
            receipt = output / 'receipts' / (key + '.json')
            existing = registry['imports'].get(key)
            if existing:
                if existing['source_digest'] != source_id:
                    raise ValueError('Source history changed after an earlier import; refusing duplicate replay.')
                if receipt.exists() and read_json(receipt)['source_digest'] == source_id:
                    existing.update(read_json(receipt))
                    registry['imports'][key] = existing
                    write_json(registry_path, registry)
                if existing['status'] == 'completed':
                    item.update(status='skipped', wandb_run_id=existing['wandb_run_id'], directory=existing.get('directory'))
                    plan['skipped'] += 1
                    continue
                raise RuntimeError('A prior import is incomplete. Inspect the registry/offline directory before retrying; automatic replay could duplicate history.')
            entry = {'local_run_id': fold.metadata['run_id'], 'wandb_run_id': key[:24], 'source_digest': source_id, 'mode': mode, 'status': 'in_progress'}
            registry['imports'][key] = entry
            write_json(registry_path, registry)
            tracker = WandbTracker(config, output / mode, sdk=sdk)
            try:
                metadata = {**fold.metadata, 'effective_config': config}
                identity = tracker.start_run(metadata, group_id, run_id=entry['wandb_run_id'], historical=True)
                if identity is None:
                    raise RuntimeError('W&B did not initialize; no import was completed.')
                entry.update(identity)
                write_json(registry_path, registry)
                validations = {r['epoch']: r for r in fold.validation}
                for row in fold.epochs:
                    for batch in fold.iterations:
                        if batch['epoch'] == row['epoch']:
                            tracker.log_batch(batch)
                    tracker.log_epoch(row)
                    tracker.log_validation(validations[row['epoch']])
                tracker.log_checkpoint(fold.folder / 'checkpoints/best.pt', fold.metadata['best_epoch'], fold.metadata['best_val_macro_f1'])
                tracker.log_test(fold.test, sorted((fold.folder / 'plots').glob('*.png')))
                tracker.finish_run('completed')
                entry['status'] = 'completed'
                write_json(receipt, entry)
                write_json(registry_path, registry)
                item.update(status='imported', **identity)
                plan['imported'] += 1
            except BaseException as exc:
                entry.update(status='failed', error=redact(f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'))
                write_json(registry_path, registry)
                raise
            finally:
                tracker.finish_run(entry['status'])
        write_json(output / 'last_import.json', plan)
        return plan
    finally:
        lock.unlink(missing_ok=True)

"""Append-only CSV and event logs, flushed on every record."""
import csv
import json
import traceback
from pathlib import Path
from src.utils.tracking import now

ITERATION_FIELDS = ['run_id', 'attempt_id', 'fold_id', 'training_seed', 'epoch', 'batch_index', 'global_step', 'batch_size', 'train_loss', 'learning_rate', 'gradient_norm', 'batch_duration_ms', 'timestamp']
LEGACY_EPOCH_FIELDS = ['attempt_id', 'epoch', 'train_online_loss', 'train_eval_loss', 'train_macro_f1', 'train_balanced_accuracy', 'val_loss', 'val_macro_f1', 'val_balanced_accuracy', 'learning_rate', 'epoch_duration_seconds', 'best_epoch', 'best_val_macro_f1']
LEGACY_VALIDATION_FIELDS = ['attempt_id', 'epoch', 'val_loss', 'val_macro_f1', 'val_balanced_accuracy', 'val_precision_per_class', 'val_recall_per_class', 'val_f1_per_class', 'is_best_checkpoint']
EPOCH_FIELDS = LEGACY_EPOCH_FIELDS.copy()
EPOCH_FIELDS.insert(EPOCH_FIELDS.index('train_macro_f1'), 'train_accuracy')
EPOCH_FIELDS.insert(EPOCH_FIELDS.index('val_macro_f1'), 'val_accuracy')
VALIDATION_FIELDS = LEGACY_VALIDATION_FIELDS.copy()
VALIDATION_FIELDS.insert(VALIDATION_FIELDS.index('val_macro_f1'), 'val_accuracy')


def append_epoch(path, row, fields, legacy):
    """Append idempotently; preserve old headers and add a v2 sidecar on legacy resume."""
    header = fields
    records = []
    if path.exists() and path.stat().st_size:
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
            reader = csv.DictReader(stream)
            header, records = reader.fieldnames, list(reader)
        if header not in (fields, legacy):
            raise ValueError(f'Log schema mismatch: {path}')
    key = (str(row.get('attempt_id', '')), str(row['epoch']))
    if not any((r.get('attempt_id', ''), r['epoch']) == key for r in records):
        append_csv(path, {k: row.get(k) for k in header}, header)
    if header == legacy and legacy != fields:
        append_epoch(path.with_name(path.stem + '.v2.csv'), row, fields, fields)


def append_csv(path, row, fields=None):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fields = fields or list(row)
    exists = path.exists() and path.stat().st_size > 0
    if exists:
        with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
            if next(csv.reader(stream)) != fields:
                raise ValueError(f'Log schema mismatch: {path}')
    with path.open('a', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=fields)
        if not exists:
            writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerow({k: json.dumps(v) if isinstance(v, (list, dict)) else v for k, v in row.items()})
        stream.flush()


class RunLogger:
    def __init__(self, folder, echo=True):
        self.folder = Path(folder)
        self.folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.echo = echo
        for name in ['training.log', 'errors.log', 'events.jsonl']:
            (self.folder / name).touch(exist_ok=True)

    def event(self, event, **details):
        row = {'timestamp': now(), 'event': event, **details}
        with (self.folder / 'events.jsonl').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
            stream.flush()
        message = f'[{event.upper()}] {details}'
        with (self.folder / 'training.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            stream.write(now() + ' ' + message + '\n')
            stream.flush()
        if self.echo:
            print(message, flush=True)

    def message(self, text):
        """Plain text only; progress bars write directly to the terminal, never here."""
        with (self.folder / 'training.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            stream.write(text + '\n')
            stream.flush()

    def iteration(self, row):
        append_csv(self.folder / 'iterations.csv', row, ITERATION_FIELDS)

    def epoch(self, row):
        append_epoch(self.folder / 'epochs.csv', row, EPOCH_FIELDS, LEGACY_EPOCH_FIELDS)

    def validation(self, row):
        append_epoch(self.folder / 'validation.csv', row, VALIDATION_FIELDS, LEGACY_VALIDATION_FIELDS)

    def error(self, error):
        with (self.folder / 'errors.log').open('a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            stream.write(now() + '\n' + ''.join(traceback.format_exception(error)) + '\n')
            stream.flush()
        self.event('failure', error=repr(error))

def read_json(relative):
    return json.loads((ROOT / relative).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))


def local_time(value):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00')).astimezone(
        timezone(timedelta(hours=7))).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S +07:00')


def create(output):
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(f'Refusing to overwrite existing journal: {output}')
    summary = read_json(f'{RESULT}/summary.json')['per_seed']['42']
    metadata = [read_json(f'{RUN}/seed_42/fold_{fold:02d}/metadata.json')
                for fold in range(1, 6)]
    start = min(local_time(item['started_at']) for item in metadata)
    end = max(local_time(item['ended_at']) for item in metadata)
    wb = Workbook()
    wb.remove(wb.active)

    def sheet(name, headers, rows):
        ws = wb.create_sheet(name)
        ws.append(headers)
        for row in rows:
            ws.append(row)
        ws.freeze_panes = 'A2'
        ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions
        for cell in ws[1]:

            cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='24527A')

"""Audit actual artifacts and render the final implementation/research report."""
import argparse
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from src.data.dataset import WindowDataset
from src.data.normalization import ChannelScaler
from src.data.splits import load_manifest
from src.evaluation.aggregation import aggregate_group
from src.training.checkpoint import load_checkpoint
from src.training.optimizer import class_weights
from src.utils.config import ROOT
from src.utils.tracking import read_json, write_json, now


def audit(group_id):
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+', group_id):
        raise ValueError('Invalid group ID.')
    group = ROOT / 'runs/experiment_e1' / group_id
    manifest = read_json(group / 'experiment_manifest.json')
    split = load_manifest(group / 'split_manifest.json')
    if manifest['status'] != 'completed':
        raise ValueError('The final audit requires all configured folds to finish.')
    summary = aggregate_group(group)
    cache = Path(manifest['cache_path'])
    checks = []
    for seed in manifest['effective_config']['training']['seeds']:
        for fold in split['folds']:
            folder = group / f'seed_{seed}' / f'fold_{fold["fold_id"]:02d}'
            metadata = read_json(folder / 'metadata.json')
            normalization = read_json(folder / 'normalization.json')
            if normalization['train_subjects'] != fold['train']:
                raise ValueError('Normalization subjects differ from the training split.')
            if set(normalization['train_subjects']) & set(fold['validation'] + fold['test']):
                raise ValueError('Normalization leakage detected.')
            dataset = WindowDataset(cache, fold['train'])
            scaler = ChannelScaler().fit(dataset)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(normalization['mean'], scaler.mean, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(normalization['std'], scaler.std, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(metadata['class_weights'], class_weights(dataset.labels).numpy(), rtol=1e-6)
            if normalization['sample_count_per_channel'] != scaler.count:
                raise ValueError('Normalization sample count mismatch.')
            last = load_checkpoint(folder / 'checkpoints/last.pt')
            best = load_checkpoint(folder / 'checkpoints/best.pt')
            selected = last['history'][metadata['best_epoch'] - 1]
            if any(row['val_macro_f1'] > selected['val_macro_f1'] + 1e-12 for row in last['history']):
                raise ValueError('Selected checkpoint does not maximize Validation Macro-F1.')
            if any(abs(row['val_macro_f1'] - selected['val_macro_f1']) <= 1e-12 and row['val_loss'] < selected['val_loss'] for row in last['history']):
                raise ValueError('Selected checkpoint violates the Validation loss tie-breaker.')
            if best['epoch'] != metadata['best_epoch'] or last['epoch'] != metadata['completed_epochs']:
                raise ValueError('Checkpoint epoch metadata mismatch.')
            checks.append({'training_seed': seed, 'fold_id': fold['fold_id'], 'normalization_train_only': True,
                           'recomputed_scaler_matches': True, 'class_weights_train_only': True,
                           'validation_selection_verified': True, 'checkpoint_epochs_verified': True,
                           'normalization_timesteps_per_channel': scaler.count,
                           'errors_log_bytes': (folder / 'logs/errors.log').stat().st_size})
    output = ROOT / 'results/experiment_e1' / group_id
    write_json(output / 'artifact_audit.json', {'status': 'passed', 'audited_at': now(), 'folds': checks,
                                               'oof_and_iteration_coverage': 'verified by aggregate_group'})
    inspection = read_json(ROOT / 'data/interim/inspection.json')
    tests = ET.parse(ROOT / 'results/pytest-results.xml').getroot().find('testsuite').attrib
    if int(tests['failures']) or int(tests['errors']):
        raise ValueError('The recorded unit test suite is not passing.')
    cache_metadata = [read_json(cache / subject / 'metadata.json') for subject in split['original_subject_order']]
    total_windows = sum(item['shape'][0] for item in cache_metadata)
    window_shape = cache_metadata[0]['shape'][1:]
    files = sorted(p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file()
                   and not any(part in {'data', 'runs', 'results', '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', '.venv'} for part in p.relative_to(ROOT).parts)
                   and p.name != 'IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md')
    nodes = {}
    for name in files + ['IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md', 'results/pytest-results.xml']:
        node = nodes
        parts = name.split('/')
        for part in parts[:-1]:
            node = node.setdefault(part, {})
        node[parts[-1]] = None
    for name in ['data/raw/WESAD', 'data/interim', 'data/processed', 'runs/experiment_e1/' + group_id, 'results/experiment_e1/' + group_id]:
        node = nodes
        for part in name.split('/'):
            node = node.setdefault(part, {})

    def render_tree(node, prefix=''):
        lines = []
        items = sorted(node.items(), key=lambda item: (item[1] is None, item[0]))
        for index, (name, children) in enumerate(items):
            last = index == len(items) - 1
            lines.append(prefix + ('└── ' if last else '├── ') + name + ('/' if children is not None else ''))
            if children:
                lines.extend(render_tree(children, prefix + ('    ' if last else '│   ')))
        return lines

    tree = 'DL13-WESAD/\n' + '\n'.join(render_tree(nodes)) + '\n'

"""Review existing WESAD preprocessing without changing data or training models."""
import argparse
from collections import Counter
import csv
import gc
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from scripts.prepare_data import cache_path
from src.data.inspection import load_subject, RATES
from src.data.resampling import resample_signal
from src.data.splits import SUBJECTS
from src.utils.config import ROOT, load_config, raw_root
from src.utils.tracking import file_hash, identifier, read_json, write_json

CLASSES = ['baseline', 'stress', 'amusement']
CHANNELS = ['ACC-x', 'ACC-y', 'ACC-z', 'BVP', 'EDA']
REFERENCE = '20261108T154303Z_474b38f9'


def read_rows(path):
    with path.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
        return list(csv.DictReader(stream))


def write_csv(path, rows):
    with path.open('w', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=list(rows[0]))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def audit(output, subject='S2'):
    config = load_config('experiments/e1_cnn/config.yaml')
    cache = cache_path(config)
    reference = ROOT / 'runs/experiment_e1' / REFERENCE / 'seed_42/fold_01'
    normalization = read_json(reference / 'normalization.json')
    if subject not in normalization['train_subjects']:
        raise ValueError('Waveform examples must come from the reference fold Train subjects.')
    if output.exists():
        raise FileExistsError('Use a new output directory; existing reports are preserved.')
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    counts, quality, input_hashes = [], [], {}
    for sid in SUBJECTS:
        folder = cache / sid
        metadata = read_json(folder / 'metadata.json')
        raw_path = raw_root() / sid / (sid + '.pkl')
        raw_hash = file_hash(raw_path)
        assert raw_hash == metadata['raw_sha256'], (sid, 'raw hash mismatch')
        assert metadata['data_config'] == config['data'], (sid, 'cache config mismatch')
        for name, expected in metadata['files'].items():
            assert file_hash(folder / name) == expected, (sid, name, 'cache hash mismatch')
        windows = np.load(folder / 'windows.npy', mmap_mode='r', allow_pickle=False)
        rows = read_rows(folder / 'windows.csv')
        assert list(windows.shape) == metadata['shape']
        assert windows.shape[1:] == (5, 960) and len(rows) == len(windows)
        assert all(r['subject_id'] == sid and int(r['original_label']) == int(r['label']) + 1 for r in rows)
        distribution = Counter(int(row['label']) for row in rows)
        assert set(distribution) <= {0, 1, 2}
        assert {str(k): distribution[k] for k in range(3)} == metadata['label_distribution']
        counts.append({'subject': sid, **{name: distribution[i] for i, name in enumerate(CLASSES)},
                       'total': len(rows)})
        for channel, name in enumerate(CHANNELS):
            array = windows[:, channel, :]
            assert np.isfinite(array).all(), (sid, name, 'NaN/Inf')
            quality.append({'subject': sid, 'channel': name,
                            'minimum': float(array.min()), 'maximum': float(array.max()),
                            'constant_windows': int(np.count_nonzero(np.ptp(array, axis=1) == 0))})
        input_hashes[sid] = {'raw_sha256': raw_hash, 'cache_files': metadata['files']}
        del windows
        print(f'Checked {sid}: {len(rows)} windows', flush=True)

    totals = {name: sum(row[name] for row in counts) for name in CLASSES}
    total = sum(totals.values())
    proportions = [{'class': name, 'windows': value, 'percentage': value / total * 100}
                   for name, value in totals.items()]
    write_csv(output / 'windows_by_subject.csv', counts)
    write_csv(output / 'class_distribution.csv', proportions)
    write_csv(output / 'channel_checks.csv', quality)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5), layout='constrained')
    bottom = np.zeros(len(counts))
    for name in CLASSES:
        values = np.array([row[name] for row in counts])
        axes[0].bar([row['subject'] for row in counts], values, bottom=bottom, label=name)
        bottom += values
    axes[0].set(title='Retained windows per subject', ylabel='Windows')
    axes[0].legend()
    axes[1].bar(list(totals), list(totals.values()), color=['#4c78a8', '#e45756', '#72b7b2'])
    for i, row in enumerate(proportions):
        axes[1].text(i, row['windows'], f"{row['windows']} ({row['percentage']:.1f}%)", ha='center', va='bottom')
    axes[1].set(title='Class distribution (overlapping windows)', ylabel='Windows')
    axes[1].margins(y=.15)
    fig.savefig(output / 'class_distribution.png', dpi=160)
    plt.close(fig)

    print(f'Loading {subject} for waveform examples only', flush=True)
    data = load_subject(raw_root(), subject)
    wrist = data['signal']['wrist']
    length = int(round(len(data['label']) / 700 * 32))
    resampled = {name: resample_signal(wrist[name], RATES['wrist'][name], 32, length)
                 for name in ['ACC', 'BVP', 'EDA']}
    combined = np.concatenate(list(resampled.values()), axis=1)
    windows = np.load(cache / subject / 'windows.npy', mmap_mode='r', allow_pickle=False)
    rows = read_rows(cache / subject / 'windows.csv')
    examples = []
    for label, name in enumerate(CLASSES):
        index, row = next((i, r) for i, r in enumerate(rows) if int(r['label']) == label)
        start = int(round(float(row['start_time']) * 32))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(combined[start:start + 960].T, windows[index], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6)
        mean = np.asarray(normalization['mean'], dtype=np.float32)
        std = np.asarray(normalization['std'], dtype=np.float32)
        normalized = ((windows[index] - mean[:, None]) / std[:, None]).astype(np.float32)
        # First 10 seconds of a fixed, first-retained window; not chosen for appearance.
        begin, end = float(row['start_time']), float(row['start_time']) + 10
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(5, 3, figsize=(15, 11), layout='constrained')
        for channel, channel_name in enumerate(CHANNELS):
            sensor = 'ACC' if channel < 3 else channel_name
            axis = channel if channel < 3 else 0
            rate = RATES['wrist'][sensor]
            lo, hi = int(np.ceil(begin * rate)), int(np.ceil(end * rate))
            raw_x = np.arange(lo, hi) / rate - begin
            raw_y = wrist[sensor][lo:hi, axis]
            processed = windows[index, channel, :320]
            time = np.arange(320) / 32
            axes[channel, 0].plot(raw_x, raw_y, linewidth=.8)
            axes[channel, 1].plot(time, processed, linewidth=.8)
            axes[channel, 2].plot(time, normalized[channel, :320], linewidth=.8)
            low, high = min(raw_y.min(), processed.min()), max(raw_y.max(), processed.max())
            margin = max(float(high - low) * .05, 1e-6)
            for column in [0, 1]:
                axes[channel, column].set_ylim(float(low - margin), float(high + margin))
            axes[channel, 0].set_ylabel(channel_name + '\noriginal units')
            for column in range(3):
                axes[channel, column].grid(alpha=.2)
                axes[channel, column].set_xlim(0, 10)
                if channel == 4:
                    axes[channel, column].set_xlabel('Seconds from excerpt start')
        for column, title in enumerate(['Original sampling rates', 'Resampled to 32 Hz', 'Standardized (Fold 1 Train scaler)']):
            axes[0, column].set_title(title)
        fig.suptitle(f'{subject} / {name} / first retained window / excerpt starts at {begin:.4f}s')
        filename = f'{subject}_{name}_preprocessing.png'
        fig.savefig(output / filename, dpi=140)
        plt.close(fig)
        examples.append({'subject': subject, 'class': name, 'window_id': row['window_id'],
                         'excerpt_start_seconds': begin, 'excerpt_duration_seconds': 10,
                         'file': filename, 'cache_reconstruction_matches': True})
        print(f'Plotted {filename}; resampled data matches cache', flush=True)
    del data, wrist, resampled, combined, windows
    gc.collect()
    write_json(output / 'audit.json', {
        'status': 'passed', 'cache': str(cache), 'raw_root': str(raw_root()),
        'total_windows': total, 'class_distribution': proportions,
        'subject_counts': counts, 'input_hashes': input_hashes,
        'waveform_examples': examples, 'normalization_reference': str(reference / 'normalization.json'),
        'normalization_sha256': file_hash(reference / 'normalization.json'),
        'waveform_policy': 'First retained window per class from a Fold 1 Train subject; display first 10 seconds.',
        'limitations': 'Counts are overlapping windows, not independent observations. Waveform review covers only the displayed excerpts. No automated physiological artifact rejection or filter tuning.',
        'data_or_training_artifacts_modified': False,
    })
    lines = ['# Kiểm tra dữ liệu trước khi làm E2/E3', '',
             f'Có {len(counts)} người và {total} cửa sổ. Mỗi cửa sổ dài 30 giây, bước 15 giây.', '',
             '| Lớp | Số cửa sổ | Tỷ lệ |', '|---|---:|---:|']
    lines += [f"| {r['class']} | {r['windows']} | {r['percentage']:.2f}% |" for r in proportions]
    constant = sum(row['constant_windows'] for row in quality)
    constant_channels = sorted({row['channel'] for row in quality if row['constant_windows']})
    lines += ['', 'Đã kiểm tra hash dữ liệu gốc/cache, cấu hình cache, nhãn, kích thước và NaN/Inf cho đủ 15 người.',
              f'Có {constant} cặp cửa sổ–kênh có giá trị không đổi hoàn toàn; xem channel_checks.csv. Đây là thống kê, không tự động coi là lỗi hay loại dữ liệu.', '',
              'Các trường hợp này thuộc các kênh: ' + ', '.join(constant_channels) + '. Một cửa sổ có thể được đếm ở nhiều kênh.', '',
              f'Ba hình tín hiệu lấy từ {subject}, thuộc Train của Fold 1. Mỗi lớp lấy cửa sổ đầu tiên, hiển thị 10 giây đầu.',
              'Ba cột lần lượt là tín hiệu gốc, sau resampling về 32 Hz và sau chuẩn hóa bằng scaler Train đã lưu.',
              'Resampling được tính lại từ dữ liệu gốc và đối chiếu khớp cache cho cả ba cửa sổ.', '',
              '- [Bảng số cửa sổ từng người](windows_by_subject.csv)',
              '- [Phân bố ba lớp](class_distribution.png)',
              '- [Kiểm tra từng kênh](channel_checks.csv)']
    lines += [f"- [{r['class']} — {subject}]({r['file']})" for r in examples]
    lines += ['', 'Chưa đổi tiền xử lý hay chạy mô hình. Ảnh chỉ minh họa các đoạn đã chọn, chưa đủ để kết luận toàn bộ dữ liệu không có nhiễu.',
              'Các cửa sổ chồng lấp nên số cửa sổ không phải số quan sát độc lập. Khi báo cáo metric chính vẫn tính theo người.',
              'Nếu chưa thấy vấn đề cụ thể cần xử lý, giữ nguyên pipeline này khi so sánh CNN, GRU và CNN-GRU.']
    (output / 'README.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'Report: {output}', flush=True)

def write_group_manifest(group, manifest):
    """Keep run lifecycle and an existing result copy in the same final state."""
    write_json(group / 'experiment_manifest.json', manifest)
    result = ROOT / 'results' / group.parent.name / group.name
